name: Mekanism Generators

unverified: Defaults are raw config values from source. Mekanism config energy values are in its internal unit (Joules); the in-game display converts to FE, so confirm the unit conversion in a running game before comparing against Powah FE/t.

tuning.effect: Generation rates, tank sizes, turbine flow, fission/fusion energy per fuel, wind Y range, meltdown toggle
Energy storage caps for heat, bio, solar, advanced solar, wind generators

items.name: Heat Generator
items.input: Burns any fuel item plus lava (and nether biome bonus)
items.notes: Natural early generator: no steel/ore chain needed beyond Mekanism basics. Direct rival to Powah Magmator/Furnator at the low end.

items.name: Bio-Generator
items.notes: Fits the grow-what-you-cannot-mine theme; check it against the crop mods.

items.name: Gas-Burning Generator
items.input: Hydrogen / ethene and other burnable gases

items.name: Industrial Turbine (multiblock)
items.input: Steam from fission or fusion, or boiler

items.name: Fission Reactor (multiblock)
items.notes: Meltdowns are on by default; direct overlap with Extreme Reactors.
